title: Creamy Vinegar Coleslaw
description: From Phil Rosenthal, the star of Netflix’s food and travel series, Somebody Feed Phil: “It’s so good, I’ve seen grown men lick empty bowls at picnics.” People Magazine Labor Day Special 2019.
ingredients: 8 cups red and green cabbage, shredded
directions: Whisk together mayo, vinegars, mustard, honey, celery salt, onion powder, garlic powder, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add cabbage and carrots to mayo mixture and toss to fully coat cabbage with dressing.
Chill the slaw at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours before serving.
